description: The union of an inclusion-chain of valid partial selection graphs is a valid partial selection graph; the empty chain gives the empty graph.
signature:

  (hchain : IsChain (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊆ x2) C) : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ChoicePrinciples.PartialSelection A (⋃₀ C)
